The CUDA hybrid panel scheduling, inner-panel diagonal factorization,
guarded reciprocal range, and bounded diagonal-first task order in
src/cuda/getrf.cu were adapted from ck_getrf::factorize_hybrid and
ck_getrf::diagonal in ck_getrf/src/getrf.cpp, and
ck_getrf::task_tile_diagonal_first in ck_getrf/include/task_order.hpp, revision
29d3ba1b67b390a43e16f963bdd87dcfe2ca4769.

Upstream source notice:
SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT AND BSD-2-Clause
Copyright (c) 2018-2025 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.

The accompanying CK, rocBLAS, and rocSOLVER notices are retained from that
source repository. No AMD runtime or CK headers are required by this CUDA path.

The ROCm CK/MFMA implementation in src/rocm/getrf/tiled.h was ported on
2026-10-06 from the ../ck_getrf working tree (including its uncommitted
optimizations). The imported src/getrf.cpp had SHA-256
237c4e72c569ac46a587664ca6a94ceab73a76c23a17f80130f3f796ca1ff1c6;
include/task_order.hpp had SHA-256
2aa0e8f6997fa5461da463145925bc29d53990dbff5fb159627874422b73d18b.
Shared task ordering, reciprocal guards, LU panel updates, triangular
recurrences and hybrid traversal now live in src/common/getrf. AMD CK/DPP
and NVIDIA MMA/cp.async implementations remain in their backend directories.
ROCm uses CK headers pinned to a8c5bd9b9ad950c3e742877e01cb784da91664e3.
